consistency.definition: an item reached in at least 60% of the runs of an arm (3 of 5)
consistency.primary_metric: share of hold-out items that are consistent, per arm

gates.D1: per-document median elapsed at most 1.35 x Z0 in the same block, 90th percentile at most 1.5 x, kills at most 10%
gates.D2: mean found fraction at least Z0 + 0.12, 90% bootstrap lower bound above Z0 + 0.04
gates.D3: consistent items at least Z0's count + 3
gates.D4: wrong blockers per run at most Z0 + 1.0, blocking findings on clean twins at most Z0 + 0.7
gates.D5: planted detection at least 0.4 on at least 3 of C2, C4, C5, C6, C8; documentation and HO-5: D2 holds with lower bound above 0, else the claim is withdrawn to plans only
gates.D6: items Z0 reaches at 0.5 or more stay within 0.1 of Z0 (blocking gate)
gates.D7: gain over K at least 0.04 on D2's metric, otherwise K wins
gates.G0: ledger_missing at most 10% in the compliance spike, luna cost per row at or below its break-even

run_counts.note: DESIGN 12.1: 3 arms x 4 documents x 5 plus Z0-raw 3 x 5; Stage 2 without SS
